<description>
This PR lets indexing code mostly run outside of the node process. It also improves indexing sync logic, which is moved out of indexing code to a new [`node::SyncChain()`](https://github.com/ryanofsky/bitcoin/blob/cf6d99bed842361fb06986780097fb80c9e879e4/src/node/chain.h#L21-L36) function.

Almost all the commits in this PR are small refactoring changes that move code from `src/index/` to `src/node/`, or replace references to node types like `CBlockIndex`, `CChain`, `CChainState` in index code. There are only two commits affecting indexing sync logic which make complicated or substantive changes:

- [`8862eddeb68b` indexes: Rewrite chain sync logic, simplify index sync code](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/24230/commits/8862eddeb68b8871421e8aa4e69c7fa567df4da5)
- [`f458cf8a4ce1` indexes: Initialize indexes without holding cs_main](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/24230/commits/f458cf8a4ce1c9a21633439122df929dbee53946)

The commit messages have more details about these and other changes. Followups to this PR will reuse indexing sync code for wallets (#15719, #11756) and let indexes run in separate processes (#10102)
</description>

<commits>
c632f91b78 kernel: Remove BlockInfo from kernel

The BlockInfo struct was moved to src/interfaces to src/kernel recently in
d3a479cb077d9a9a4451dc4ecb43fe0daf94f172 from #34079 which does not really make
sense because the BlockInfo struct is meant to be used by wallets and indexes
and is not referenced by kernel code.

The change moves the `BlockInfo` struct back from kernel to interfaces and
moves the `MakeBlockInfo` function from kernel to node. The `MakeBlockInfo`
function never belonged in the kernel was never used by it. It was added there
before the kernel library had taken shape, when it was unclear what the
node/kernel boundary would look like.

f951cdcaa9 indexes, doc: Document current m_best_block_index behavior

Try to document race conditions and corner cases and idiosyncracies in current
indexing code to make upcoming changes easier to understand.

09601cbece indexes: Avoid race, make -reindex-chainstate more efficient

Avoid a race condition in index startup where indexes set m_synced = true too
early, while there are still notifications from previously connected blocks in
the validationinterface queue, causing those blocks to trigger the Rewind()
call in the BaseIndex::BlockConnected notification handler, and pointlessly
remove and then re-append the same blocks.

This race condition was easy to reproduce just by running the
test/functional/feature_coinstatsindex.py "Test that the index works with
-reindex-chainstate" test.

This change also allows getting rid of the "WARNING: Block %s does not connect
to an ancestor of known best chain (tip=%s); not updating index" warning.

527f7a7921 indexes, refactor: Remove index RegisterValidationInterface call

Add new interfaces::Chain::attachChain method and start moving index sync logic
out of src/index/ to src/node/. In this commit, move code that registers for
index validationinterface notifications. In later commits, move the actual sync
thread and add real blockConnected, blockDisconnected, and chainStateFlushed
implementations.

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

8868334eb1 indexes, refactor: Remove index validationinterface hooks

Split up and rename validationinterface callback functions
BaseIndex::BlockConnected to BaseIndex::IgnoreBlockConnected and
BaseIndex::ChainStateFlushed to BaseIndex IgnoreChainStateFlushed.

Most of the code in these functions was just ignoring spurious notifications,
so leave that code in place, but move the rest of the code to
BaseIndexNotifications::blockConnected and
BaseIndexNotifications::chainStateFlushed. In an upcoming commit the spurious
notifications will be dropped and the new BaseIndex::Ignore... methods will be
deleted entirely.

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

5cccb53adb indexes, refactor: Stop incorrectly calling Interupt() and Stop() in BaseIndex destructor

This code never worked and was never used. Now that an m_handler member is
added, the incorrect usage is easier to detect and an assert can be added.

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

be90ba78bc indexes, refactor: Add Commit CBlockLocator& argument

This commit does not change behavior in any way. Goal of this change is to
document behavior better and make it more explicit.

530d8dc994 indexes, refactor: Move Append call from BaseIndex::Sync to blockConnected

Start moving indexing code from BaseIndex::Sync() to blockConnected() so
indexes can be separated from the node and do not need to implement syncing.
More index-specific code will be moved from Sync() to blockConnected() in
upcoming commits and then the Sync method will be dropped.

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

e6e5653cec indexes, refactor: Move Commit logic out of ThreadSync to notification handlers

This commit also improve behavior always committing when
block.status == BlockInfo::FLUSHED_TIP, so latest index data is always committed at
the end of the background sync. It was always intended behavior to
commit at the end of a sync but bugfix
3679f1ecf5ec25d9a40a23e48797a8c22fa3cb99 changed behavior to skip
committing in the case where the index best block is ahead of the most
recently flushed best block. The bugfix was an improvement because
committing ahead of the node best block is bad, because it can make
index data unrecoverable in the even of a crash. But committing behind
the node best block is not ideal either because index data will be
stale. Committing at the node flush best block as implemented by this
commit is a better behavior than either. (TODO: maybe implemnt this
behavior as a separate PR?)

77d2a591b2 indexes: Call notification handlers from Sync()

Call notification handlers from Sync() to consolidate block processing, moving
m_synced logic out of Sync() into the handlers.

Previously, BaseIndex::Sync() maintained its own process_block lambda
and called Rewind() directly when the sync thread encountered a reorg,
separate from the blockConnected/blockDisconnected notification handlers
used during live operation. This commit refactors Sync() to call the
same notification handlers instead, so block append and rewind logic
lives in one place rather than two.

The commit is primarily a refactoring, but introduces one minor
behavioral change: index entries for disconnected blocks are now removed
eagerly as blocks disconnect, rather than being deferred until the
replacement block connects. Previously, during a reorg window,
gettxspendingprevout would return stale (pre-reorg) index data until
the new chain tip arrived; now the index reflects disconnections
immediately. The txospenderindex functional test is updated accordingly.

ce89fd1b1d indexes: Add blockfilterindex mutex

Add BlockFilterIndex::m_filter_mutex to avoid TSAN errors in next commit moving
index sync thread from indexes to node. This mutex was previously neccessary,
but TSAN did not detect errors until the sync thread was moved.

c2bff5d03d test: prevent race condition in feature_init.py

The next commit changes index code to avoid spawning sync threads with
no syncing is required. This means 'txindex thread start', 'block filter
index thread start', 'coinstatsindex thread start' messages will not be
logged every startup, only when syncing is required.

In current the feature_init.py test, this change could a introduce a
race condition if the test is not able to kill the node fast enough for
syncing to be necessary on the next restart, so 'thread start' messages
would not show up.

Fix this by treating 'thread start' logs differently and checking for
them in earlier restarts, not just in the latest restart.

cbcf5221c0 indexes: Move sync thread from index to node

A large part of this change is move-only with sync code moving from
index/base.cpp to src/node/chain.cpp.

There is a small change in behavior here where sync threads will not be
started if syncing is not necessary (previously they were always
started and the feature_init.py test needed to be updated previous
commit to account for this). Otherwise behavior should be the same.

a85e898c7a indexes, refactor: Remove SyncWithValidationInterfaceQueue call

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

9171e838d9 indexes: Rewrite chain sync logic, simplify index sync code

Add SyncChain method and improve Chain::attachChain behavior so it no longer
sends notifications from the sync thread at the same time as notifications from
validationinterface queue. This allows BaseIndex::m_ready variable and
surrounding logic to be dropped and indexing code to be simplified.

It is also a potential performance improvement since it avoids holding cs_main
while processing all indexing notifications. Previously cs_main was held while
sending some notifications in the attachChain sync thread.

c858f24f1d indexes, refactor: Remove UndoReadFromDisk calls from indexing code

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

83301858bb indexes, refactor: Remove remaining CBlockIndex* pointers from indexing code

This commit does not change behavior in any way.

bbb1c9e816 Remove direct index -> node dependency

Replace last m_blockman.UpdatePruneLock call with
interfaces::Chain::updatePruneLock call.
</commits>
